programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Jin Chuan mengimbau kembali masanya bersama Lei yang telah melindunginya sehingga mengorbankan nyawanya. Ibu Wenxue menerima penghinaan Qianna/ Xiao Ai di depan Kimura dan Wenxue apabila pulang melawat Yunyun di hospital mental.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Kuro melawat Yufei di hospital. Dia marah apabila menyedari bahawa Yufei kini buta. Dia memutuskan untuk membalas dendam terhadap Yunyun. Kimura Kenji dengan sengaja menunjukkan kepada Liu keintimannya dengan Wenxue.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Ivan dibawa oleh Jia Feng ke pejabat. Mereka diserang oleh kumpulan lelaki yang berkenalan dengan Jia Feng semasa dalam perjalanan. Jia Feng sebaliknya menuduh Ivan yang bermusuhan dengan orang yang tidak dikenali.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17
programme.desc: Selepas mengulangi senario keenam, Zhengxing mendapati Shi Xiong, abang Chunhua dan juga tabib Cina menggunakan penyakit Kusta untuk mencari wang. Shi Xiong juga bekerjasama dengan pemilik rumah pelacur untuk menyebarkan penyakit itu.

programme.title: TOP SINGERS
programme.desc: Huang Yu Han dan Wu Ying Jing berjaya mara ke pusingan seterusnya selepas menewaskan cabaran Lin Zhong Yi yang tersingkir. Bagi perlawanan kumpulan Weng Yu Jun dan Lin Xiu Qi, mereka berdua kini berdepan cabaran Zhang Yu Ru.

programme.title: HO CHAK! 2025/2026
programme.desc: Episod ini hos Orange diiringi oleh Penyampai Berita 8TV Zhou Xiu Yang, mengunjungi 3 restoran di sekitar Petaling Jaya untuk mengesyorkan hidangan enak kepada para penonton. Restoran yang dikunjungi adalah JS Cafe di Taman SEA, PJ.

programme.title: YOU'RE JUST NOT HER
programme.desc: Haly menyedari kekecewaan Lam Shun terhadap Ou Man yang pernah abai membantunya. Bagi memulihkan keadaan, Haly menemui Ou Man untuk memujuknya meyakinkan pihak atasan agar membenarkan Lam Shun membuka gerai baharu.

programme.title: JOY OF LIFE SEASON 2
programme.desc: Putera Cheng Ze terkejut dengan kemunculan Fan Wu Jiu di tempat kejadian. Fan Wu Jiu sebenarnya telah diarah oleh Putera Cheng Ze untuk menculik Fan Si Zhe. Putera Cheng Ze menyedari beliau terperangkap dalam strategi Fan Xian.

programme.title: JOY OF LIFE SEASON 2
programme.desc: Lai Ming Cheng meminta Maharaja menurunkan pangkat Fan Xian dan bapanya Fan Jian sebagai hukuman ke atas penglibatan Fan Si Zhe dalam perniagaan Bao Yue Lou dan hukuman ke atas Putera Cheng Ze kerana terlibat dalam penyeludupan.

programme.title: JOURNEY TO HOMELAND
programme.desc: Episod ini pengacara Jack Tan mengembara ke Grisek, Johor untuk menghayati kehidupan dan budaya di bandar tersebut dan bertemu bual dengan Yang Quan Yun, pemilik kedai kopi Thong Lok Hui yang menetap di Grisek selama 60 tahun.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)

programme.title: SEE HER AGAIN
programme.desc: Yit Seng, pegawai atasan Kwong Yiu, dipaksa melindungi aktiviti haram kumpulan jenayah, kerana isterinya berhutang besar dengan ceti haram. Kwong Yiu yang mengekori dan menyiasat Yit Seng menyedari Yit Seng digertak kumpulan jenayah.

programme.title: THE MEMOIR OF MAJIE
programme.desc: Yu Hong mencintai Chen Hui walaupun dia tahu yang dia adalah seorang MAJIE.

programme.desc: Ivan memberi nasihat kepada Jing Yi supaya memutuskan hubungan dengan Xin Xuan. Ivan membongkarkan bahawa ibu Xin Xuan (Cai Xia) menghalang Xin Xuan berkawan dengan Jing Yi. Cai Xia juga memberikan wang 20 ribu kepada Ivan

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (251 - 450)

programme.title: THE UNUSUAL PROSECUTOR

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of "an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold."

programme.title: Zero Hour 1
programme.desc: As China sets its sights on achieving carbon neutrality by 2060, young people across the country are looking for creative solutions to help reach that goal. At Tsinghua University, students are learning to become stewards of the planet through research, policymaking, and storytelling. Meanwhile, students in Shenzhen have developed new methods for collecting and using rainwater, innovative grass-planting methods in Inner Mongolia are making China's deserts more habitable, and renewable energy is gradually replacing traditional energy sources. Perhaps the dream of carbon neutrality is closer than we thought.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of "an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold."

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people's southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder. Though he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden's journey as we explore his life in rural China.

programme.title: Four Faces of Muqam
programme.desc: Muqam is a performing art with its roots in the folklore of Xinjiang. Rather like an encyclopedia, Muqam is a record of the history and lifestyle of the local Uygur people. It originated in folk culture, with lyrics that covered everything from philosophical aphorisms to folk tales. Muqam is an integral part of Xinjiang culture, a vehicle for Uygur people to express their feelings and ideas.

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China. In this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui Museum, show the amazing giant bronze mask, exquisite gold stuff, marvelous bronze divine tree etc., re-explore this mysterious and great civilization 3000 years ago.

programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people's southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Four Faces of Muqam

It originated in folk culture, with lyrics that covered everything from philosophical aphorisms to folk tales. Muqam is an integral part of Xinjiang culture, a vehicle for Uygur people to express their feelings and ideas.

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China. In this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui Museum, show the amazing giant bronze mask, exquisite gold stuff, marvelous bronze divine tree etc., re-explore this mysterious and great civilization 3000 years ago.

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China. In this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui Museum, show the amazing giant bronze mask, exquisite gold stuff, marvelous bronze divine tree etc., re-explore this mysterious and great civilization 3000 years ago.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji's countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China's east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China's largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess's birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good fortune. We then learn how silk was manufactured centuries ago, before seeing how imperial‑grade silk is being reinvented for modern‑day fashion.

programme.title: Valentine's for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community's brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine's Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess's birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good fortune. We then learn how silk was manufactured centuries ago, before seeing how imperial‑grade silk is being reinvented for modern‑day fashion.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji's countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: عبور الجبال والأنهار 1‏
programme.desc: يركّز هذا الفيلم على الجسور العالية ذات المستوى العالمي، وينطلق من فكرة ‏«‏رؤية كفاح الصين من خلال آلاف الجسور الممتدة‏»‏، ليعكس بعمق إنجازات تشييد الجسور والبنية التحتية للنقل في مقاطعة قويتشو، ويقدّم عرضًا بانوراميًا للتحولات الكبرى في تنميتها، مجسّدًا روح الصين.‏

programme.title: على صهوة الحصان‏
programme.desc: هو عمل وثائقي أصلي موجّه للجمهور الدولي، يتمحور حول رمز الحصان في الأبراج والثقافة الصينية. يتكوّن من أربع حلقات وثائقية قصيرة مستقلة، ترتبط برؤية واحدة تقدّم منظورًا خاصًا لدلالات الحصان في الثقافة الصينية، وتُظهر كيف تتجدّد هذه الرمزية وتستمر في الحياة المعاصرة بأشكال وتعبيرات جديدة.‏

programme.title: عبور الجبال والأنهار 1‏
programme.desc: يركّز هذا الفيلم على الجسور العالية ذات المستوى العالمي، وينطلق من فكرة ‏«‏رؤية كفاح الصين من خلال آلاف الجسور الممتدة‏»‏، ليعكس بعمق إنجازات تشييد الجسور والبنية التحتية للنقل في مقاطعة قويتشو، ويقدّم عرضًا بانوراميًا للتحولات الكبرى في تنميتها، مجسّدًا روح الصين.‏

programme.title: القصة التي وجدتها في الصين - جنبا إلى جنب‏
programme.desc: يرغب طفل في الاستماع إلى حكايات جدّه، لكنه سئم سماع الأساطير القديمة التي يعرفها عن ظهر قلب. هذه المرة، يقرّر الجد أن يروي له قصة من واقع تجربته الشخصية، عن رحلة خاضها في الشرق الأقصى، بعيدا عن الوطن. ينطلق الممثل المصري الشهير ورئيس مهرجان القاهرة السينمائي الدولي، حسين فهمي، في رحلة إلى الصين، من المعالم التاريخية في بكين إلى الحدائق والبحيرات الساحرة في منطقة جيانغنان، ومن تجارب استكشاف الثقافة التقليدية إلى عوالم التكنولوجيا المتطورة التي تستشرف المستقبل. وفي كل محطة، يكتشف أشياء جديدة، ويقترب من حكايات إنسانية غير متوقعة. كيف يتمكّن شاب لا يستطيع مغادرة سريره، ويعتمد على جهاز التنفس الاصطناعي للبقاء على قيد الحياة، من بناء عالمه الخاص والانطلاق نحو آفاق واسعة؟ ولماذا يكرّس بعض الأشخاص عقودا من حياتهم لمواجهة زحف الصحراء؟ وعندما يبدو الفوز بعيد المنال، ما الذي يدفع مجموعة من اللاعبين الهواة من مدينة صينية حدودية صغيرة إلى خوض مباراة تكاد تكون فرص الفوز فيها معدومة؟ تمزج السلسلة الوثائقية، المؤلفة من ثلاثة أجزاء، ‏"‏القصة التي وجدتها في الصين‏"‏، بين رحلة حسين فهمي الحقيقية في الصين وأسلوب سردي يستحضر أجواء الحكايات الخيالية، لتأخذ المشاهدين في رحلة لاكتشاف حيوات تسع مجموعات من الصينيين العاديين، وتسلّط الضوء على قصصهم وتجاربهم اليومية. إنها حكايات عن الروابط الأسرية والشغف والشجاعة والاختيارات المصيرية، قصص إنسانية قد تدفعنا، نحن أيضا، إلى إعادة النظر في حياتنا وما تمنحه لنا من فرص ومعان.‏

programme.title: الأبطال من حولنا ١‏
programme.desc: في القصص أو في الواقع، غالبًا ما ترتبط صورة الأبطال في أذهان الناس بما هو غير عادي، بعيدًا عن البساطة اليومية. وتوجّه سلسلة الأفلام الوثائقية القصيرة ‏«‏الأبطال من حولنا ‏»‏ عدستها نحو الطيّبين من عامة الناس، لترصد حياتهم وأعمالهم، وتُبرز ما يختزنونه من قوة متراكمة وصلابة، وتكشف عن البريق الكامن خلف مظهرهم العادي.‏

programme.title: القصة التي وجدتها في الصين - جنبا إلى جنب‏
programme.desc: يرغب طفل في الاستماع إلى حكايات جدّه، لكنه سئم سماع الأساطير القديمة التي يعرفها عن ظهر قلب. هذه المرة، يقرّر الجد أن يروي له قصة من واقع تجربته الشخصية، عن رحلة خاضها في الشرق الأقصى، بعيدا عن الوطن. ينطلق الممثل المصري الشهير ورئيس مهرجان القاهرة السينمائي الدولي، حسين فهمي، في رحلة إلى الصين، من المعالم التاريخية في بكين إلى الحدائق والبحيرات الساحرة في منطقة جيانغنان، ومن تجارب استكشاف الثقافة التقليدية إلى عوالم التكنولوجيا المتطورة التي تستشرف المستقبل. وفي كل محطة، يكتشف أشياء جديدة، ويقترب من حكايات إنسانية غير متوقعة. كيف يتمكّن شاب لا يستطيع مغادرة سريره، ويعتمد على جهاز التنفس الاصطناعي للبقاء على قيد الحياة، من بناء عالمه الخاص والانطلاق نحو آفاق واسعة؟ ولماذا يكرّس بعض الأشخاص عقودا من حياتهم لمواجهة زحف الصحراء؟ وعندما يبدو الفوز بعيد المنال، ما الذي يدفع مجموعة من اللاعبين الهواة من مدينة صينية حدودية صغيرة إلى خوض مباراة تكاد تكون فرص الفوز فيها معدومة؟ تمزج السلسلة الوثائقية، المؤلفة من ثلاثة أجزاء، ‏"‏القصة التي وجدتها في الصين‏"‏، بين رحلة حسين فهمي الحقيقية في الصين وأسلوب سردي يستحضر أجواء الحكايات الخيالية، لتأخذ المشاهدين في رحلة لاكتشاف حيوات تسع مجموعات من الصينيين العاديين، وتسلّط الضوء على قصصهم وتجاربهم اليومية. إنها حكايات عن الروابط الأسرية والشغف والشجاعة والاختيارات المصيرية، قصص إنسانية قد تدفعنا، نحن أيضا، إلى إعادة النظر في حياتنا وما تمنحه لنا من فرص ومعان.‏

programme.title: الأبطال من حولنا ١‏
programme.desc: في القصص أو في الواقع، غالبًا ما ترتبط صورة الأبطال في أذهان الناس بما هو غير عادي، بعيدًا عن البساطة اليومية. وتوجّه سلسلة الأفلام الوثائقية القصيرة ‏«‏الأبطال من حولنا ‏»‏ عدستها نحو الطيّبين من عامة الناس، لترصد حياتهم وأعمالهم، وتُبرز ما يختزنونه من قوة متراكمة وصلابة، وتكشف عن البريق الكامن خلف مظهرهم العادي.‏

programme.title: القصة التي وجدتها في الصين - جنبا إلى جنب‏
programme.desc: يرغب طفل في الاستماع إلى حكايات جدّه، لكنه سئم سماع الأساطير القديمة التي يعرفها عن ظهر قلب. هذه المرة، يقرّر الجد أن يروي له قصة من واقع تجربته الشخصية، عن رحلة خاضها في الشرق الأقصى، بعيدا عن الوطن. ينطلق الممثل المصري الشهير ورئيس مهرجان القاهرة السينمائي الدولي، حسين فهمي، في رحلة إلى الصين، من المعالم التاريخية في بكين إلى الحدائق والبحيرات الساحرة في منطقة جيانغنان، ومن تجارب استكشاف الثقافة التقليدية إلى عوالم التكنولوجيا المتطورة التي تستشرف المستقبل. وفي كل محطة، يكتشف أشياء جديدة، ويقترب من حكايات إنسانية غير متوقعة. كيف يتمكّن شاب لا يستطيع مغادرة سريره، ويعتمد على جهاز التنفس الاصطناعي للبقاء على قيد الحياة، من بناء عالمه الخاص والانطلاق نحو آفاق واسعة؟ ولماذا يكرّس بعض الأشخاص عقودا من حياتهم لمواجهة زحف الصحراء؟ وعندما يبدو الفوز بعيد المنال، ما الذي يدفع مجموعة من اللاعبين الهواة من مدينة صينية حدودية صغيرة إلى خوض مباراة تكاد تكون فرص الفوز فيها معدومة؟ تمزج السلسلة الوثائقية، المؤلفة من ثلاثة أجزاء، ‏"‏القصة التي وجدتها في الصين‏"‏، بين رحلة حسين فهمي الحقيقية في الصين وأسلوب سردي يستحضر أجواء الحكايات الخيالية، لتأخذ المشاهدين في رحلة لاكتشاف حيوات تسع مجموعات من الصينيين العاديين، وتسلّط الضوء على قصصهم وتجاربهم اليومية. إنها حكايات عن الروابط الأسرية والشغف والشجاعة والاختيارات المصيرية، قصص إنسانية قد تدفعنا، نحن أيضا، إلى إعادة النظر في حياتنا وما تمنحه لنا من فرص ومعان.‏

programme.title: Konsert Jom Heboh KL 2026
programme.desc: Kemeriahan konsert karnival paling ikonik di Malaysia kini diteruskan ke lokasi seterusnya! Konsert Jom Heboh KL 2026 membawakan persembahan live penuh tenaga daripada barisan artis tempatan popular, termasuk Man Bai, Bella Astillah, Syamel, Ernie Zakri, Black, Kristal X, Kai Deva, K.O.I, Floor 88, Drama Band, dan Mary Grace, bersama barisan hos Kieran, Keymi, Fizi Ali dan Muaz! Strim secara langsung dari Stadium Merdeka pada 28 dan 29 November 2026 (Sabtu & Ahad) mulai jam 9.00 malam. Dapatkan Pas Strim Langsung 2 Hari anda dengan harga hanya RM3 untuk menikmati keseluruhan persembahan sepanjang hujung minggu di Tonton!

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: Major League Pickleball Asia
programme.desc: Major League Pickleball (MLP) arrives in Asia this November, featuring six professional co-ed teams competing over five weeks for the inaugural MLP Asia title. The competition features Women's Doubles, Men's Doubles and Mixed Doubles matches, with teams battling through pool rounds and semifinals before the champions are crowned on Super Saturday. If the match ends in a 2–2 tie, the exciting DreamBreaker™ singles game will determine the winner. Get ready for fast-paced action, intense rallies and thrilling team competition!

programme.title: SANTAI 5-8
programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

programme.desc: Rehatkan minda anda pada penghujung hari bersama Shah, Faruk & Mimie dalam segmen KONA MAI. programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".
But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We're back with a big helping of the funniest pet videos on the internet, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud.Stir-crazy hamsters, tortoises with a bad attitude, sweary parrots - they're all here

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The extremly cute capybara loves massage, black-footed penguins from Africa show off their superb diving abilities, be careful cause mini pigs aren't mini in size at all, subverting your imagination towards them, and uncovering ecology of the incredible gentle giant giraffe. "Cute Pet Guide" invites you to a trip to the zoo full of surprises!

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: National Anthem
programme.desc: The broadcast of Malaysia’s national anthem, Negaraku, marks the beginning of the daytime broadcast schedule.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us is a compilation of human-interest stories from around the world. This episode features a Women-run hotel in Sri Lanka that empowers women through the tourism industry. It also highlights Traditional wooden toy-making in Channapatna, India, where local artisans strive to preserve their craft amid modernisation and competition from imported products. Efforts to save the northern white rhino at Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya continue through in vitro fertilisation (IVF) technology to prevent the subspecies from becoming extinct. Meanwhile, Benin’s textile industry is expanding its local manufacturing capabilities, shifting from raw cotton exports to textile production to create jobs and boost the country’s economy. The episode also explores the importance of international engagement and dialogue in helping countries such as Malaysia compete in an increasingly interconnected world.

programme.title: Global Perspective
programme.desc: This episode of Global Perspective discusses the evolution of Malaysia’s foreign policy since Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim took office in November 2022, focusing on strengthening ties with Islamic countries in areas including the Palestinian issue, economic cooperation, education and moderation. The programme also highlights Malaysia’s strategic relations with Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan and Central Asia, as well as the potential for international media collaboration to strengthen diplomacy and deliver accurate information to global audiences.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us explores diverse cultural traditions, artistic expressions and heritage from around the world, including ice carving in Japan, a unique peanut butter art installation in Rotterdam, Arabian horse traditions in Palestine and camel racing in Australia. This episode also highlights the traditional fishing practices of the Imragan community in Mauritania, France’s return of historical Syrian artefacts, and Malaysia’s strategic role in strengthening international relations and amplifying the voices of the Global South.

programme.title: ASEAN - Rasa ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa ASEAN is an 11-episode travelogue featuring fusion cuisine from ASEAN countries while showcasing local cultures and traditions. Hosted by Chef Fikri and Chef Naim, the programme brings together professional and renowned chefs to explore the region’s diverse culinary heritage.\n\nIn this episode, both chefs travel to Cambodia to discover its local cuisine and cultural traditions.

programme.title: ASEAN - Jejak Halal ASEAN
programme.desc: Jejak Halal ASEAN is a travelogue exploring the diverse cultures and lifestyles of Muslim communities across ASEAN countries. In this episode, the programme travels to Songkhla, Thailand, to discover the local Muslim community and its way of life.

programme.title: ASEAN -Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: This episode of ASEAN Women Entrepreneurship highlights the determination of women entrepreneurs from Cambodia and Brunei in developing their businesses and contributing to economic growth. It also explores the challenges they face, the importance of support systems, and business strategies in empowering women to succeed in entrepreneurship.

programme.title: ASEAN - Rasa ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa ASEAN is an 11-episode travelogue featuring fusion cuisine from ASEAN countries while showcasing local cultures and traditions. Hosted by Chef Fikri and Chef Naim, the programme pairs them with professional and renowned chefs to explore the region’s diverse culinary heritage. In this episode, the two chefs explore Indonesian cuisine in Malaysia, discovering its distinctive flavours and culinary influences.

programme.title: ASEAN - Jejak Halal ASEAN
programme.desc: Jejak Halal ASEAN is a travelogue exploring the diverse cultures and lifestyles of Muslim communities across ASEAN countries. In this episode, the programme travels to Hatyai, Thailand, to discover the local Muslim community and its way of life.

programme.title: Muslim World - Syahadah : Uzbekistan

programme.title: Signal 1203
programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.title: 同学八宝箱
programme.desc: 嗨，小朋友们！欢迎来到《同学八宝箱》！这是一个藏着无数秘密和惊喜的超级宝箱！只要轻敲三下，里面就会跳出好听的童话故事、神奇的科学冷知识，还有超级爆笑的校园趣事！无论是在上学路上、放学途中，还是睡前的陪伴时刻，快和我们一起打开八宝箱，收获满满的快乐和智慧吧！

programme.title: City Papago 城市趴趴走
programme.desc: 真正的旅行，不在于去过多少地方，而在于是否真正融入过当地的生活。《城市趴趴走》带你跳出千篇一律的旅游攻略，走进各大城市的街头巷尾。我们带你探寻历史街区的建筑余温，打卡本地人流连的菜市场与深夜食堂，听原住民讲述古老而新鲜的故事。从古朴小镇到摩登都市，请收拾好心情，随我们一起漫步街头，体验最地道、最富有烟火气的城市微旅行。

programme.title: 音乐下午茶Teabreak
programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: 孤芳自赏
programme.desc: 在快节奏与商业大片的喧喧嚷嚷之外，总有一些电影选择安静地立于角落，散发着独一无二的光芒。这里是《孤芳自赏》，一处专属于高冷影迷与独立电影的声音（视觉）放映厅。\n\n我们带你穿透繁复的光影，解读那些被低估的冷门佳作、艺术大师的独行之作，以及镜头深处最隐秘的人性角落。不追热门，不作媚俗之语。今夜，让我们在独立的光影世界里，孤芳自赏。

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a 'Luk Krok' for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

programme.title: Rooftop
programme.desc: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Tear Us Apart
programme.desc: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

programme.title: The Getaway
programme.desc: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: The Elite of Devils
programme.desc: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

programme.title: Detrimental

When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.
